title: CODATA 2022: the neutron mass is 1.674 927 500 56 × 10⁻²⁷ kg
summary: In u, 1.008 664 916 06. The energy equivalent is 939.565 421 94 MeV. The neutron is slightly heavier than the proton in this listing.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'neutron mass 1.674 927 500 56 e-27' kg, standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 85 e-27' kg. 'neutron mass in u 1.008 664 916 06', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 40' u. 'neutron mass energy equivalent in MeV 939.565 421 94', standard uncertainty '0.000 000 48' MeV. Set next to the proton mass on the same listing, the neutron's mass is larger. The listing also prints a neutron-proton mass ratio of 1.001 378 419 46 with standard uncertainty 0.000 000 000 40.
